Build useful English

Week 3 · Lesson 2 — School Subjects and Supplies

Today's goal

I can name school subjects and supplies and ask about a child's school day.

What you will hear

You will listen to useful questions about school, and three simple school instructions. Press the blue button next to a phrase to hear it.

Useful questions and answers

ASKWhat subject does your child study?
ANSWERMy child studies English.
ASKDo you have homework today?
ANSWERYes, I have a science worksheet.
ASKWhere is your notebook?
ANSWERHere is my notebook.
ASKWhat do you need for school?
ANSWERI need my pencil and worksheet.

Simple school instructions

Please bring your worksheet.
Use your pencil for maths.
Complete your science homework.
